positions.name: OnboardingProcessInstitutionalization
positions.frame: how is the onboarding process established as a settled institutional norm?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same directional read: the Pallasine checklist is presented as a ratified, non-negotiable institutional artifact. src-1 states the universal mandate (every new hire completes it, with named components), and src-2 grounds it in institutional history (it replaced the old wiki page last quarter). The shared matter-of-fact register, authority-ranking relational stance, and conservation value read cohere across both — the checklist is not argued for but asserted as established fact, with src-2 supplying the supersession that confirms its settled status.
